title: Outer JSON whitespace preserves two verbatim alert versions through restart and refetch
notes: Both alert versions and their extra fields are synthetic. Each body has all four RFC 8259 whitespace characters before its opening array bracket and whitespace after its closing bracket.
Exact originalRecord equality includes the JSON number x: 1.5, literal UTF-8 é, the distinct JSON escape \u00e9 and internal whitespace, excluding every byte outside the record object.
The two versions share an identity and source time but have different normalized message hashes. Their original records remain in ingest order across both restarts and the unchanged refetch.
